title: Dining Etiquette: Jó étvágyat and Dining Formulas

sections.content:
Before beginning any meal, Hungarians say:
- **Jó étvágyat kívánok!** = Enjoy your meal! (Standard reply: *Köszönöm, viszont kívánom!* = Thank you, likewise!)
- After finishing: *Egészségedre váljék!* (May it become to your health!) or *Köszönöm a finom ételt!* (Thank you for the delicious food!)

items.english: Thank you very much for the wonderful hospitality!
